Bournemouth beat Celta Vigo 2-1 with 10 men for a 10th straight win

Marco Rose · Sport

Bournemouth won 2-1 at Celta Vigo in the Europa League after coming from behind with 10 men. It was their 10th victory in a row in all competitions under Marco Rose, and it moves them a step closer to automatic qualification for the last 16. They were a goal and a man down at half-time.

Reported by The Guardian. Written by AI.
